source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli elementi pompanti di una pompa di iniezione in linea comprimono il gasolio ad alta pressione destinato agli iniettori

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, in-line injection pump elements compress diesel to high pressure for the injectors.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli elementi pompanti di una pompa di iniezione in linea sono sempre in numero pari

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the number of pumping elements in an in-line injection pump is always even.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli elementi pompanti di una pompa di iniezione in linea devono essere smontati e puliti ogni 30 giorni circa

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the pumping elements of an in-line injection pump must be removed and cleaned approximately every 30 days.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli elementi pompanti non necessitano di manutenzione se si utilizza bioDiesel

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, pumping elements need no maintenance if biodiesel is used.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel, l'anticipo automatico serve ad anticipare la mandata del gasolio agli iniettori

records.localized_text: In diesel engines, automatic advance brings forward diesel delivery to injectors.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel, l'anticipo automatico serve a garantire una buona combustione del gasolio anche ad elevato numero di giri del motore

records.localized_text: In diesel engines, automatic advance ensures good combustion even at high rpm.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel, l'anticipo automatico entra in funzione all'aumentare del numero dei giri del motore

records.localized_text: In diesel engines, automatic advance operates as engine rpm increases.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel, l'anticipo automatico gestisce l'innesto della frizione

records.localized_text: In diesel engines, automatic advance controls clutch engagement.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel, l'anticipo automatico gestisce l'innesto delle marce alte del cambio di velocità

records.localized_text: In diesel engines, automatic advance controls engagement of high gears.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel, l'anticipo automatico attiva le candele di accensione del gasolio

records.localized_text: In diesel engines, automatic advance activates diesel ignition spark plugs.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori iniettano nei cilindri gasolio ad alta pressione

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, injectors inject high-pressure diesel into the cylinders.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori sono dotati di un dispositivo che polverizza il gasolio in ingresso nei cilindri

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, injectors have a device that atomizes diesel entering the cylinders.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori devono essere periodicamente controllati

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori sono spesso controllati elettronicamente da una centralina

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors are often electronically controlled by a control unit.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, il controllo elettronico degli iniettori permette di stabilire tempi e durata dell'iniezione del gasolio nei cilindri

records.localized_text: Electronic control of diesel injectors determines injection timing and duration in the cylinders.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori iniettano gasolio nei cilindri a bassa pressione

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors inject fuel into cylinders at low pressure.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori si trovano incorporati nella pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors are incorporated in the injection pump.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori iniettano periodicamente olio lubrificante nel cilindro

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors periodically inject lubricating oil into the cylinder.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori cessano di iniettare gasolio dieci secondi dopo lo spegnimento del motore

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors stop injecting fuel ten seconds after the engine is switched off.

source.text_it: Il motore Diesel aspira aria mentre il gasolio viene introdotto nei cilindri dagli iniettori

records.localized_text: A diesel engine draws in air while diesel is introduced into cylinders by injectors.

source.text_it: I motori Diesel sono sempre dotati di iniettori

records.localized_text: Diesel engines always have injectors.

source.text_it: Se gli iniettori di un motore Diesel gocciolano, il motore emette fumo nero

records.localized_text: If diesel injectors drip, the engine emits black smoke.

source.text_it: Nel motore Diesel, la combustione avviene in "eccesso d’aria"

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, combustion takes place with excess air.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, si possono trovare gli iniettori-pompa, dispositivi che rendono inutile la presenza della pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: A diesel engine may have unit injectors, which make an injection pump unnecessary.

source.text_it: Il Common-rail è un dispositivo che permette l’iniezione del gasolio nei cilindri ad altissima pressione

records.localized_text: Common rail permits diesel injection into cylinders at extremely high pressure.

rows.text: In an inline pump, each pumping element pressurizes diesel fuel and sends it to the injector for its cylinder.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

rows.text: The number of elements depends on the cylinders, not on whether the number is even: an inline pump has one element per cylinder.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

rows.text: There is no general rule requiring the elements to be dismantled and cleaned every 30 days. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions and service the system according to its condition.
evidence: Delphi, Tips and guidance for testing the fuel injection system: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/tips-and-guidance-for-testing-the-fuel-injection-system — injector wear and leaks; testing during maintenance.

Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

YANMAR, integrated fuel injection pump overhaul: https://staging.ye-shipsweb-test.yanmar.com/sms/recondition/piston/ — overhaul considers running hours and internal condition; Perkins, Scheduled maintenance: https://www.perkins.com/en_GB/aftermarket/maintenance/preventive-maintenance/scheduled-maintenance.html — schedules vary by engine.

rows.text: Biodiesel does not eliminate the need for checks and maintenance: it can also contribute to deposits in the fuel system.
evidence: Perkins, Quality cleaning and conditioning: https://www.perkins.com/en_GB/aftermarket/maintenance/engine-fluids/cleaner-and-conditioner.html — biodiesel and blends can form fuel-system deposits; follow engine fluid recommendations.

Delphi, Tips and guidance for testing the fuel injection system: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/tips-and-guidance-for-testing-the-fuel-injection-system — injector wear and leaks; testing during maintenance.

DEUTZ Technical Circular 0199-99-01218/6, biodiesel: https://www.deutz.com/fileadmin/user_upload/produkte/kraftstoffe_der_zukunft/tr_0199_99_01218_6_en.pdf — biodiesel can create deposits and clogging in injection systems.

rows.text: The automatic advance changes the pump’s delivery timing, advancing it relative to the engine position when needed.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

rows.text: At high engine speed there is less time available for combustion. Advancing delivery helps injection start at the appropriate time.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

rows.text: In the mechanical system, the advance varies with engine speed, advancing delivery as speed rises.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

rows.text: Automatic advance controls diesel delivery timing; it does not engage the clutch, which belongs to the transmission.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

rows.text: Automatic advance concerns diesel delivery timing, not the selection of transmission gears.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

rows.text: Advance controls delivery timing; it does not activate spark plugs. In a diesel engine, fuel ignites from the heat of compressed air.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel distributor fuel-injection pumps, “Diesel fuel-injection systems: an overview” and “Timing device”: https://manualmachine.com/bosch/dieseldistributorfuelinjectionpumps/28650590-technical-instruction/ — inline pump has one plunger per cylinder; timing device advances delivery with engine speed.

US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

rows.text: The injectors deliver pressurized diesel fuel into the combustion chamber, where it mixes with hot compressed air.
evidence: Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

rows.text: The injector nozzle breaks the diesel into small droplets, helping it mix with air and burn.
evidence: US Environmental Protection Agency, Combined Heat and Power Partnership, Catalog of CHP Technologies, March 2015, section 2.3.2.2, p. 2-7: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2016/09/f33/catalog_of_chp_technologies.pdf — fine injector atomization and dispersion promote combustion.

rows.text: Injectors can wear or leak and should be checked according to the manufacturer’s instructions to verify proper operation.
evidence: Delphi, Tips and guidance for testing the fuel injection system: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/tips-and-guidance-for-testing-the-fuel-injection-system — injector wear and leaks; testing during maintenance.

YANMAR YDG Operation Manual, p. 59: https://www.yanmar.com/eu/industrial/wp-content/uploads/sites/11/2021/06/YANMAR-Operation-Manual-YDG-Series.pdf — inspect, clean and test injection nozzle if necessary at scheduled interval.

rows.text: In electronically controlled diesel systems, the control unit operates the injectors, regulating injection for each cylinder.
evidence: Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

rows.text: The control unit determines when to operate the injector and for how long, thereby metering the fuel delivered.
evidence: Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

Bosch, Common-rail injectors, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/parts/diesel_parts_1/pdf_30/en_5/repairs_on_diesel_systems_bosch.pdf — ECU opens and closes injector nozzle using switching valves.

Bosch, Fuel injection system catalogue, p. 6: https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/parts_11/diesel_parts/pdf_70/bosch-fuel-injection-system-catalogue.pdf — ECU controls injector timing and duration.

rows.text: Diesel injection takes place at high pressure, which helps atomize the fuel; it is not low-pressure delivery.
evidence: Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

US Environmental Protection Agency, Combined Heat and Power Partnership, Catalog of CHP Technologies, March 2015, section 2.3.2.2, p. 2-7: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2016/09/f33/catalog_of_chp_technologies.pdf — fine injector atomization and dispersion promote combustion.

rows.text: In a conventional system, injectors are by the cylinders and receive fuel from the pump; they are not incorporated into the separate pump. Unit injectors, however, combine the two functions.
evidence: Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

Bosch, Unit pump system and unit injector system: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/unit-pump-and-unit-injector-system-ohw/ — unit injector combines high-pressure pump and nozzle; separate unit-pump system uses a high-pressure line.
The false statement is read as describing a separate conventional pump; unit injectors integrate pump and nozzle.

rows.text: The fuel-system injectors deliver diesel for combustion, not lubricating oil.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

rows.text: Normally, a diesel engine is stopped by cutting fuel injection, which brings the engine to a stop; there is no need to wait ten seconds after it stops for the injectors to stop injecting.
evidence: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, S16R Operation & Maintenance Manual, Chapter 2, p. 2-2, Stop Switch and Stop Solenoid: https://generator-info.com/Engine%20Manuals/Mitsubushi/Mitsubishi%20S16R%20Manual.pdf — the normal stop solenoid moves the injection-pump rack to stop injection, shutting down the engine; stopping injection precedes engine shutdown, rather than continuing for ten seconds after it.

rows.text: A diesel engine draws in and compresses air; the injector then delivers diesel fuel into the hot compressed air, where it ignites.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

rows.text: In a diesel engine, fuel enters the combustion chamber by injection: the injector delivers and distributes it.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — Diesel compresses intake air and sprays fuel into it for compression ignition.

Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

rows.text: A dribbling injector can impair combustion and contribute to black smoke; smoke color alone cannot identify the fault with certainty.
evidence: Parker Racor, Products Technical Guide, p. 9, Exhaust Smoke: https://oceomarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Parker-RacorU%CC%88ru%CC%88nKatalog%CC%86u.pdf — dribbling injection can cause black smoke through incomplete combustion; other causes exist.

rows.text: A diesel normally operates with more air than theoretically needed to burn its fuel: this is excess air.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Diesel Power: Clean Vehicles for Tomorrow, Part 2, Exhaust Gas Recirculation: https://www1.eere.energy.gov/vehiclesandfuels/pdfs/diesel_technical_primer.pdf — diesel engines operate with lean fuel-air ratios and excess air, particularly at low load.

Robert Bosch GmbH, Diesel Engine Management, Basic principles of diesel fuel injection, Mixture distribution and Lambda levels in diesel engines: https://studylib.net/doc/25652593/bosch---diesel-engine-management — excess air is the overall intake air mass above the theoretical amount needed to burn the fuel; local mixture conditions differ.

rows.text: In a unit injector, the high-pressure pump and nozzle form one unit for the cylinder, so no separate common injection pump is needed.
evidence: Bosch, Unit pump system and unit injector system: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/unit-pump-and-unit-injector-system-ohw/ — unit injector combines high-pressure pump and nozzle; separate unit-pump system uses a high-pressure line.

rows.text: In common rail, a pump maintains fuel at high pressure in a shared rail that supplies the cylinder injectors.
evidence: Bosch, Common-rail system with piezo injectors: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump, rail, cylinder injectors and individual electronic injection control.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1eaee-2f70-7610-aba0-122b1e56ce0b
issues: 29375: The cited Cummins manual describes a stop lever as a troubleshooting measure when the engine will not stop; it does not establish the claimed normal shutdown sequence or that injection never continues for a fixed ten seconds. Supply authoritative evidence for the explanation or qualify it to what is supported.

29379: The cited DOE Advanced Combustion Strategies page describes a locally fuel-lean mixture immediately upstream of the flame, not the general overall diesel excess-air claim. Replace or supplement the citation with an authoritative source supporting that claim, such as DOE Diesel Power: Clean Vehicles for Tomorrow, https://www1.eere.energy.gov/vehiclesandfuels/pdfs/diesel_technical_primer.pdf.
